arxiv-2105-11353.title: Change Point Detection in Nonstationary Sub-Hourly Wind Time Series
arxiv-2105-11353.creator: Sakitha Ariyarathne, Harsha Gangammanavar, Raanju R. Sundararajan
arxiv-2105-11353.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a nonparametric method for detecting change points in multivariate nonstationary wind speed time series. The change point detection method identifies changes in covariance structure and decomposes the nonstationary multivariate time series into stationary segments. We also present parametric and nonparametric approaches to model and simulate new time series within each stationary segment.

arxiv-2202-05338.title: Accountability in an Algorithmic Society: Relationality, Responsibility, and Robustness in Machine Learning Conference: 2022 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency; June 21–24, 2022; Seoul, Republic of Korea 2022 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAc
arxiv-2202-05338.creator: A. Feder Cooper, Emanuel Moss, Benjamin Laufer, Helen Nissenbaum
arxiv-2202-05338.description: Abstract . In 1996, Accountability in a Computerized Society ( Nissenbaum 1996 ) issued a clarion call concerning the erosion of accountability in society due to the ubiquitous delegation of consequential functions to computerized systems. Nissenbaum 1996 described four barriers to accountability that computerization presented, which we revisit in relation to the ascendance of data-driven algorithmic systems—i.e.

arxiv-2203-01559.title: Neural Architecture Search using Progressive Evolution
arxiv-2203-01559.creator: Nilotpal Sinha, Kuan-Wen Chen
arxiv-2203-01559.description: Abstract Vanilla neural architecture search using evolutionary algorithms (EA) involves evaluating each architecture by training it from scratch, which is extremely time-consuming. This can be reduced by using a supernet to estimate the fitness of every architecture in the search space due to its weight sharing nature.

arxiv-2210-10580.title: Correspondance de Simpson p p -adique II : fonctorialité par image directe propre et systèmes locaux de Hodge-Tate
arxiv-2210-10580.creator: Ahmed Abbes et Michel Gros
arxiv-2210-10580.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ahmed Abbes et Michel Gros. Faltings a dégagé en 2005 un analogue p p -adique de la correspondance de Simpson (complexe) dont la construction a été reprise par différents auteurs, selon plusieurs approches. Poursuivant celle que nous avons initiée dans [ 3 ] , nous développons dans la présente monographie de nouveaux aspects de la correspondance de Simpson p p -adique, inspirés par notre construction de la suite spectrale de Hodge-Tate relative [ 2 ] .

arxiv-2302-10618.title: Attractors for Flow Observables in 2 + 1 2+1 D Bjorken Flow
arxiv-2302-10618.creator: Victor E. Ambru s ,, Sören Schlichting, Clemens Werthmann
arxiv-2302-10618.description: Abstract We examine the capabilities of second-order Israel-Stewart-type hydrodynamics to capture the early-time behaviour of the quark-gluon plasma created in heavy-ion collisions. We point out that at very early times, the dynamics of the fireball is governed by the local 0+1-D Bjorken flow attractor due to the rapid expansion along the longitudinal direction.

arxiv-2304-13309.title: Robustness of the intrinsic anomalous Hall effect in Fe 3 ​ GeTe 2 \mathrm{Fe}_{3}\mathrm{GeTe}_{2} to a uniaxial strain
arxiv-2304-13309.creator: Mijin Lim, Byeonghyeon Choi, Minjae Ghim, Je-Geun Park, Hyun-Woo Lee
arxiv-2304-13309.description: Abstract Fe 3 ​ GeTe 2 \mathrm{Fe}_{3}\mathrm{GeTe}_{2} (FGT), a ferromagnetic van der Waals topological nodal line semimetal, has recently been studied. Using first-principles calculations and symmetry analysis, we investigate the effect of a uniaxial tensile strain on the nodal line and the resultant intrinsic anomalous Hall effect (AHE). Our results reveal their robustness to the in-plane strain.

arxiv-2305-13205.title: Neutron Proton Scattering for S, P and D Waves using Deng-Fan Potential by Phase Function Method
arxiv-2305-13205.creator: Ayushi Awasthi, O.S.K.S. Sastri
arxiv-2305-13205.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ayushi Awasthi, O.S.K.S. Sastri. In this paper, the np - scattering phase shifts and cross section for S,P and D partial waves have been obtained for energies below the pion threshold, by considering Deng-Fan potential as model of interaction. The radial time independent Schrödinger equation has been analytically solved using Nikiforov - Uvarov method to obtain the energy expression for ground state of np system. Utilising this, the scattering phase shifts for S 1 3 {}^{3}S_{1} have been obtained using phase function method.

arxiv-2306-07135.title: On the Amplification of Linguistic Bias through Unintentional Self-reinforcement Learning by Generative Language Models — A Perspective
arxiv-2306-07135.creator: Minhyeok Lee
arxiv-2306-07135.description: Abstract Generative Language Models (GLMs) have the potential to significantly shape our linguistic landscape due to their expansive use in various digital applications. However, this widespread adoption might inadvertently trigger a self-reinforcement learning cycle that can amplify existing linguistic biases.

arxiv-2401-17314.title: Labeled Random Finite Sets vs. Trajectory Random Finite Sets
arxiv-2401-17314.creator: Ronald Mahler, Eagan MN, USA, EML: mahlerronald@comcast.net
arxiv-2401-17314.description: Abstract The paper [ 12 ] discussed two approaches for multitarget tracking (MTT): the generalized labeled multi-Bernoulli (GLMB) filter and three Poisson multi-Bernoulli mixture (PMBM) filters. The paper [ 13 ] discussed two frameworks for multitarget trajectory representation—labeled random finite set (LRFS) and set of trajectories (SoT)—and the merging of SoT and PMBM into trajectory PMBM (TPMBM) theory.

arxiv-2404-17636.title: Lorentz violating backgrounds from quadratic, shift-symmetric, ultralight dark matter Preprint: IPPP/24/21, DESY-24-056
arxiv-2404-17636.creator: Minyuan Jiang, Benjamin D. Pecjak, Gilad Perez, Somasundaram Sankaranarayanan
arxiv-2404-17636.description: Abstract We consider an effective theory for a shift-symmetric, quadratically-coupled, ultralight spin-0 field. The leading CP conserving interactions with Standard Model fields in the effective theory arise at dimension 8. We discuss the renormalization group evolution and positivity bounds on these operators, as well as their possible UV origins.

pmc-10559246.creator: Khanda Latif Abdalla, Trefa Mohammed Ali Mahmood
pmc-10559246.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundIn orthodontic procedures, mini-implants are routinely used as temporary anchorage devices. Early failure is primarily attributed to a variety of issues, which are mostly connected to the quality and geometry of the screw that lead to insufficient primary stability.ObjectivesTo evaluate the primary stability of different sizes and brands of orthodontic mini-implants by optimizing the insertion torque value (ITV) and to clear out which one has the greatest primary stability among the most widely used mini-implants by orthodontists.MethodsEighty-two self-drilling mini-implants from three different

pmc-10565876.title: Pulse-SILAC and Interactomics Reveal Distinct DDB1-CUL4–Associated Factors, Cellular Functions, and Protein Substrates
pmc-10565876.creator: Jennifer Raisch, Marie-Line Dubois, Marika Groleau, Dominique Lévesque, Thomas Burger, Carla-Marie Jurkovic, Romain Brailly, Gwendoline Marbach, Alyson McKenna, Catherine Barrette, Pierre-Étienne Jacques, François-Michel Boisvert
pmc-10565876.description: Cullin-RING finger ligases represent the largest family of ubiquitin ligases. They are responsible for the ubiquitination of ∼20% of cellular proteins degraded through the proteasome, by catalyzing the transfer of E2-loaded ubiquitin to a substrate. Seven cullins are described in vertebrates.

pmc-10604964.title: Knowledge, Beliefs, and Behaviors of Turkish Parents about Childhood Vaccination
pmc-10604964.creator: Zuhal Emlek Sert, Sevcan Topçu, Aysun Çelebioğlu, Nicoletta Iacovidou, Abraham Pouliakis, Ilias Chatziioannidis
pmc-10604964.description: Background and Objectives: Vaccination is critical to the prevention and control of infectious disease outbreaks and is also one of the most important public health successes. When it comes to childhood vaccinations, parents’ consent is very important. For this reason, childhood vaccination rates are directly related to the knowledge, beliefs, and behaviors of the parents.

pmc-10675649.title: Application of Zeolites and Zeolitic Imidazolate Frameworks in Dentistry—A Narrative Review
pmc-10675649.creator: Laura Jiaxuan Li, Chun-Hung Chu, Ollie Yiru Yu, Carnevale Gianluca, Michele Bianchi
pmc-10675649.description: Zeolites and zeolitic imidazolate frameworks (ZIFs) are crystalline aluminosilicates with porous structure, which are closely linked with nanomaterials. They are characterized by enhanced ion exchange capacity, physical–chemical stability, thermal stability and biocompatibility, making them a promising material for dental applications. This review aimed to provide an overview of the application of zeolites and ZIFs in dentistry.

pmc-11359151.title: Isolation and Characterization of Exosomes from Cancer Cells Using Antibody-Functionalized Paddle Screw-Type Devices and Detection of Exosomal miRNA Using Piezoelectric Biosensor
pmc-11359151.creator: Su Bin Han, Soo Suk Lee, Tibor Hianik
pmc-11359151.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Exosomes are small extracellular vesicles produced by almost all cell types in the human body, and exosomal microRNAs (miRNAs) are small non-coding RNA molecules that are known to serve as important biomarkers for diseases such as cancer. Given that the upregulation of miR-106b is closely associated with several types of malignancies, the sensitive and accurate detection of miR-106b is important but difficult.

pmc-11389561.title: As a novel prognostic model for breast cancer, the identification and validation of telomere-related long noncoding RNA signatures
pmc-11389561.creator: Wei Zhao, Beibei Li, Mingxiang Zhang, Peiyao Zhou, Yongyun Zhu
pmc-11389561.description: BackgroundTelomeres are a critical component of chromosome integrity and are essential to the development of cancer and cellular senescence. The regulation of breast cancer by telomere-associated lncRNAs is not fully known, though. The goals of this study were to describe predictive telomere-related LncRNAs (TRL) in breast cancer and look into any possible biological roles for these RNAs.

pmc-11392002.title: Short-term outcomes of implanting a retropupillary iris-claw intraocular lens in patients with lens and intraocular lens drops
pmc-11392002.creator: Chalid Kurniawan, Arief S Kartasasmita, Ohisa Harley
pmc-11392002.description: Lens drop and intraocular lens (IOL) drop can occur after cataract or phacoemulsification surgery, where the IOL is dislocated from the capsular bag into the vitreous cavity. The aim of this study was to investigate the short-term outcomes of implanting a retropupillary iris-claw in patients with IOL drop and lens drop after phacoemulsification.

pmc-11416205.title: Management of Crohn’s Disease and Its Complexities: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-11416205.creator: Peddi Pavani, Balakrishna Ravella, Krish Hitesh Patel, Niragh Sikdar, Neeraj Kancherla, Tamer Zahdeh, Resheek Nerella
pmc-11416205.description: This case report and literature review explore Crohn's disease (CD), a chronic inflammatory disorder of the gastrointestinal tract characterized by unpredictable flare-ups and remissions. The study highlights the diverse clinical manifestations, including abdominal pain, diarrhea, and weight loss, which significantly affect quality of life.

pmc-11459442.title: Breast cancer with cervix, lung and neck metastases: a case report and literature review
pmc-11459442.creator: Xiaomei Wang, Shumei Wei
pmc-11459442.description: BackgroundBreast cancer has the potential to metastasize to various sites; however, cases of metastasis to the cervix are rare. Here, we present clinical and pathological data from a rare case of primary breast cancer metastasis to the cervix, including imaging characteristics and clinical progression.Case DescriptionA 68-year-old female patient self-detected nodules in her right breast.

pmc-11462893.title: Nanomaterial-mediated host directed therapy of tuberculosis by manipulating macrophage autophagy
pmc-11462893.creator: Yilin Liu, Jiajun Wang, Jiayi Yang, Jiaojiao Xia, Jiaqi Yu, Dongsheng Chen, Yuhe Huang, Fen Yang, Yongdui Ruan, Jun-Fa Xu, Jiang Pi
pmc-11462893.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Tuberculosis (TB), induced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) infection, remains a major public health issue worldwide. Mtb has developed complicated strategies to inhibit the immunological clearance of host cells, which significantly promote TB epidemic and weaken the anti-TB treatments. Host-directed therapy (HDT) is a novel approach in the field of anti-infection for overcoming antimicrobial resistance by enhancing the antimicrobial activities of phagocytes through phagosomal maturation, autophagy and antimicrobial peptides.

pmc-12425983.title: Editorial: Vascular malformations: advancements, debates, and consensus
pmc-12425983.creator: Kaiying Yang, Yi Ji
pmc-12425983.description: though isolated lesions usually have limited clinical impact, syndromic vascular malformations can cause profound functional impairment and may be life-threatening. Given their complex clinical presentations, a deeper understanding of their clinical manifestations, underlying pathogenesis, genetic determinants, and therapeutic approaches is crucial.

pmc-12601914.title: Induction of apoptosis and growth inhibition by silodosin and abiraterone acetate in PC-3 human prostate cancer cells
pmc-12601914.creator: Lukman Hakim, Zakaria Aulia Rahman, Furqan Hidayatullah, Anthony Chi-Fai Ng
pmc-12601914.description: PurposeProstate cancer that progresses despite androgen deprivation therapy, known as metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) is notoriously difficult to treat. While abiraterone acetate (AA) is a standard therapy, repurposing drugs like silodosin, a selective α1A-adrenoceptor antagonist, offers promising potential.Materials and MethodsPC-3 human prostate cancer cells were treated with silodosin, AA, or their combination.

pmc-12661682.title: Human-like associations between gut microbiome composition and inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity in dogs
pmc-12661682.creator: Attila Salamon, Attila Szabó, Tamás Felföldi, Soufiane Bel Rhali, Attila Andics, Ádám Miklósi, Enikő Kubinyi, Márta Gácsi
pmc-12661682.description: BackgroundEvidence suggests a link between attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and the gut microbiome in humans. Dogs are a valuable model for ADHD research, as their gut microbiome more closely resembles the human gut microbiome in composition and functional overlap compared to rodent models. This study investigated potential associations between dogs’ ADHD-related traits and gut microbiome composition/diversity.

pmc-13084002.title: The importance of regulated resource reallocation during dynamic environmental shifts in yeast
pmc-13084002.creator: Rachel A Kocik, Eli G Cytrynbaum, Jamie M Ahrens, Megan N McClean, Audrey P Gasch
pmc-13084002.description: Many organisms maintain generalized stress responses activated by adverse conditions. A common theme is the induction of stress-defense proteins with reduced production of growth-promoting proteins, including ribosomes. Yet the precise roles of these coupled programs are difficult to dissect. Here, we investigated Saccharomyces cerevisiae responding to salt as a model stressor.

pmc-13085690.title: Digital health system integration in Ghana: a scoping review of governance arrangements, interoperability aspirations, and regulatory gaps
pmc-13085690.creator: Simon Nyarko, Roger A. Atinga, Dennis Bardoe, Abigail N. Owusu
pmc-13085690.description: BackgroundDigital health systems are increasingly central to health system performance, yet many low- and middle-income countries continue to struggle with integrating proliferating platforms into coherent national infrastructures. These challenges are often attributed to technical or capacity constraints, but less attention has been paid to how digital health integration is governed in practice.

pmc-13188584.title: Determinants of antenatal care and skilled birth attendance utilization in Bangladesh: evidence from the 2022 Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey
pmc-13188584.creator: Sarmin Aktar, Papia Sultana
pmc-13188584.description: BackgroundMaternal health services, including antenatal care (ANC) and skilled birth attendance (SBA), are crucial for improving maternal and child health outcomes. Despite global efforts, many women in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), including Bangladesh, do not have adequate access to these services.

pmc-13335278.title: Echocardiographic changes following dual-chamber pacemaker implantation at a Malaysian tertiary heart center
pmc-13335278.creator: Si Ling Soh, Ian J. Y. Wee, Rowina Lynne Murray binti Jeffery Murray, Suraya Hani Kamsani, Aslannif Roslan, Azlan Hussin
pmc-13335278.description: BackgroundDual-chamber pacemaker implantation restores atrioventricular synchrony, but it might be associated with alterations in ventricular mechanics and valvular function. The echocardiographic effects of dual-chamber pacing in contemporary practice remain incompletely characterized.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective single-center study of patients who underwent dual-chamber pacemaker implantation and had transthoracic echocardiography performed before and after implantation in 2022.

pmc-13388951.title: Targeting druggable kinases in neuropathic pain
pmc-13388951.creator: Harrison Benson, Komalpreet Kaur, Mahmoud Salama Ahmed
pmc-13388951.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Despite the prevalence of neuropathic pain and the opioid crisis, there has been little progress in the development of non-opioid alternative therapies. Protein kinases orchestrate multiple key pathophysiological events in the progression of pain signaling pathways. This review highlights druggable kinases and the associated scaffolds as well as molecular modalities to reverse mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in neuropathy models whether preclinically or clinically.

pmc-13475248.title: Ionic self-assembled supramolecular polymers: synthesis, properties and applications
pmc-13475248.creator: Juanjuan Wang, Xin Li, Guoheng Xu, Hongdeng Qiu, Jia Chen
pmc-13475248.description: Ionic self-assembled supramolecular polymers (IS-SPs), emerging as a class of dynamically tunable functional materials, are generated via ionic self-assembly driven primarily by electrostatic interactions (primarily electrostatic forces, hydrogen bonding, metal coordination, etc.). Over the past two decades, IS-SPs have garnered substantial research interest owing to their exceptional properties and broad application prospects.

pmc-13577393.title: Role of Rab4A in the enhancement of cancer cell invasion induced by plasma samples collected during radiotherapy in patients with triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-13577393.creator: Benoit Paquette, Hélène Therriault, Isabelle Gauthier, Sawyna Provencher, Jean-Marc Bourque, Sahar Naasri, Ayman Oweida, Sameh Geha, Pascale Labrecque, Jean-Luc Parent
pmc-13577393.description: The relapse rate for early-stage triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is significantly higher than that of other breast cancer subtypes. To reduce the relapse rate, we evaluated the relevance of targeting Rab4A to inhibit the increase in cancer cell invasion induced by radiotherapy (RT).

pmc-13675127.title: The hidden consequences of marine heatwaves: rising Vibrio risk in European coastal waters
pmc-13675127.creator: Jan C Semenza, Joaquin A Trinanes, Jaime Martinez-Urtaza
pmc-13675127.description: heatwaves dominate public attention, because of their immediate impacts on human health, they often overshadow equally profound changes occurring in the oceans. During the same month, the western Mediterranean Sea and adjacent Atlantic coastal waters experienced a record-breaking marine heatwave.
